Cyber protection
Secure the digital core as you transform the business
Embed cybersecurity by design to modernize and function at speed and scale.
Why cyber protection matters
Digital transformation can leave businesses vulnerable to cyber-attacks. A majority of CEOs admit their cyber resilience is lacking, but there's hope. By embedding cybersecurity and streamlining tools, companies can protect their digital core and reduce risks. This isn't just about defense; it's about empowering businesses to thrive securely in the digital age.
DATA
Toggle accordion
60%
of CEOs said they perform common cyber resilience practices, but recognize that’s not enough
90%
of CEOs said they consider cybersecurity a differentiating factor to help build trust among customers
Embed cybersecurity by design
Organizations can’t find the time, money and people they need to modernize cybersecurity so it can function at speed and scale.
What you can do
Secure AI at scale
Generative AI and Agentic AI are introducing new opportunities—and new risks. Prioritizing secure AI accelerates adoption and builds trust.
Learn more
Defend your organization from deepfakes and reinforce trust and resilience
As these sophisticated digital manipulations become more prevalent, organizations need to fortify their defenses and effectively shield themselves from deepfake threats. Organizations must act quickly to reinforce trust and resilience. A combination of enhanced security capabilities, robust controls and employee education and awareness is critical.
Learn more
223%
Increase since 2023 in the buying and selling of deepfake-related tools on major dark web forums.
Embed cybersecurity across the lifecycle
Secure the digital core by embedding security at every stage of the lifecycle to protect your applications, workloads, containers and cloud environments of every kind.
Combine the power of zero trust and SASE to take a holistic approach to cybersecurity
Optimize your security tools and posture by centralizing your data, control plans and endpoint protection. By integrating domains such as identity, cloud, infrastructure, network and security, you can increase their scalability and simplicity.
Learn more
Build a strong identity and access management foundation
Strengthen your digital identity based on efficiently managing enterprise and privileged access, enforcing endpoint protection, modernizing capabilities and automating provisioning at scale.
Embed cybersecurity into your enterprise platforms
Protect your core enterprise platform services by hardening environments, protecting endpoints and improving monitoring, security testing, access controls, intrusion detection, governance, risk and compliance.
Safeguard emerging technologies
Navigate the path forward for emerging technologies, reaping their benefits and mitigating their vulnerabilities to ensure safety, resiliency and sustainability.
What you’ll achieve
Right-size cybersecurity
Consolidate vendors and tools, retire legacy debt and leverage existing licenses to reduce costs up to 30-40%, then reinvest in modernization.
Modernize cybersecurity
Rapidly modernize and embed cybersecurity when replatforming applications and services in the cloud to accelerate deployment up to 25-40%.
Evolve cybersecurity
Reduce risk from unauthorized access up to 30% through tool orchestration, automation and cybersecurity posture maintenance.
